_comment: CI-only settings fragment for the AI-SDLC Orchestrator plugin's brownfield mode. Merge these entries into .claude/settings.json (project scope) or ~/.claude/settings.json (user/machine scope) so a headless CI run doesn't hang waiting for permission approvals on every git command the discovery agent needs. This fragment is illustrative — the plugin never modifies your settings.json automatically; copy the entries yourself.

env._note: Add your own credentials here so CI can dispatch. Never commit real values — use CI-native secret injection (GitHub Actions secrets, GitLab CI variables, etc.) and let CI write these fields at job start.
